title: TLS checks disabled (helm) — review required
description: helm is told to skip TLS verification: helm upgrade --insecure-skip-tls-verify. Scripted clients then accept any certificate, exposing automation credentials and data. This lexical rule flags the flag; the reviewer confirms it is test-only or removes it.
remediation: Remove the flag and trust via valid cluster certificates.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches the flag regardless of environment.
